description: Your own documents gathered from your Barmaan account: calibration certificates, invoices, quotations and proformas, order summaries, files attached to your service requests and messages, project deliverables and application files. Newest first. Filter by folder (contracts, quotations, invoices, drawings, reports, certificates, uploads, other), kind, source, status (active, expired, withdrawn), q (title, number, extension) or an issued date range (from/to, YYYY-MM-DD). Also returns per-folder counts. partial_sources lists sources that failed to load (an empty list means every source answered). Page with next_cursor.

cursor.description: Value of next_cursor from the previous page.

q.description: Title, document number or file extension.
